info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Wholesale Trading Operational Actions API
info.description: The Wholesale Trading Operational Actions API enables financial institutions to execute various operational activities related to trader positions in wholesale trading. This API facilitates actions such as modifying, managing, and executing operational commands tied to trader positions, streamlining workflows for trading operations. Typical consumers include trading desks, financial analysts, and compliance teams who utilize the API for maintaining accurate and timely trader data. By integrating this API, organizations can enhance their trading operations while ensuring regulatory compliance and operational efficiency.

post.summary: Create a new operational action for trader positions.
post.description: This operation allows you to create a new operational action for managing trader positions within wholesale trading. It enables users to perform specific actions that can impact the status or management of trader positions in the system.
